body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Prinics(www.prinics.com) expects to showcase its innovative photo frame printer 'PFP-8W' at the upcoming CES 2009 held in Las Vegas.

Combined a digital photo frame with a photo printer, it also supports mp3 playback. Coming in 7- and 8-inch monitor, it can print photos in six different sizes; 5x7, 5x (passport), 5x4, 3.5x4.5, 3x4, and 2.5cm x 3cm.
